plan: Given the private value of $29, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly above the expected value of competitors' bids to maximize profit. Since other bidders are rational and values range from $0 to $20, they may bid close to their value. A bid of $19.1 maximizes the chance of winning while ensuring profit since the prize value is much higher than the maximum possible second-highest bid.

My value is $29, but rational bidders will not bid above their own value. To maximize profit, bid slightly below my value to ensure winning if others bid close to their values. A bid of $19.9 ensures winning unless others irrationally overbid their values. This balances winning likelihood and profit margin.

Given my private value of $22, I aim to bid just below this value to maximize profit if I win. Since all bidders are rational, they will likely bid close to their values. By bidding slightly below $22, I can outbid competitors with values slightly less than mine while still securing a profit. A bid of $21.9 ensures I win against any lower value bids while minimizing the cost if I win.
